name: Scheme of Assistance to State Scheduled Castes Development Corporations
benefit:
- Financial assistance in the form of margin money loans at low rate of interest.
- Subsidy provision to reduce repayment liability of beneficiaries.
- The quantum and ceiling of subsidy is the same as for schemes under Integrated Rural Development Programme.
- Credit support facilitation through tie-ups with financial institutions, banks, National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporat
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must belong to Scheduled Castes. - The applicant must be living below the poverty line.
